item.title: Early in 2026, Gold Extends Rally as Antam Breaks Rp 2.7 Million
item.description: Jakarta. Gold prices at state-owned miner Antam surged to a fresh record at the start of the week, underscoring strong momentum in both domestic and global bullion markets. Antam’s 1-gram gold bar jumped Rp 40,000 on Monday to Rp 2,703,000 ($159.75), setting a new all-time high. The previous record stood at Rp 2.675 million, reached on Jan. 15, 2026. item.title: Rp 6.6 Trillion Disbursed for Sekolah Rakyat Program in 2025
item.description: Jakarta. President Prabowo Subianto has inaugurated the operations of 166 Sekolah Rakyat schools nationwide at the start of 2026, with state spending reaching Rp 6.6 trillion ($390.02 million) as of last year. item.title: Prajogo Pangestu Buys Rp 9.6 Billion Worth of Barito Renewables Energy
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesian tycoon Prajogo Pangestu has increased his stake in Barito Renewables Energy (BREN) after snapping up one million shares in a series of on-market transactions on Jan. 15, 2026. According to a disclosure filed with the Indonesia Stock Exchange on Monday, Prajogo purchased the shares at prices ranging from Rp 9,525 to Rp 9,675 per share, spending a total of Rp 9.6 billion ($566,425). item.title: Indonesia Told Not to Rush with $6 Billion State Textile Firm Plan
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia is facing calls not to rush with its plan to set up a multi-billion-dollar state textile firm, with businesses saying that it would be better for the government to establish a fund dedicated to beef up the industry. item.title: Toll in Spain Train Collision Rises to at Least 39 Dead as Rescuers Search for More Bodies
item.description: Adamuz, Spain. Spanish police said Monday that at least 39 people died in the high-speed train collision Sunday in southern Spain and rescue efforts were continuing. The collision occurred when the tail end of a train traveling between Malaga and Madrid with some 300 passengers went off the rails near Cordoba at 7:45 p.m. It slammed into a train coming from Madrid to Huelva, another southern Spanish city, according to rail operator Adif. item.description: Jakarta. item.title: Indonesia Stocks Finish Higher as Investors Await BI Rate Announcement
item.description: Jakarta. Indonesia’s benchmark Jakarta Composite Index (JCI) closed Monday’s session at a fresh all-time high of 9,133, gaining 58 points or 0.64%, as it moved within the 9,025–9,110 range. item.title: Search Teams Find Second Body in ATR 42 Plane Crash
item.description: Makassar, S. Sulawesi. Search and rescue teams on Monday found a second victim from an ATR 42-500 aircraft operated by Indonesia Air Transport (IAT) that crashed in mountainous terrain in South Sulawesi, authorities said, as efforts continued in extreme conditions to recover the remaining victims. The body, identified as female, was located on the third day of search operations in the rugged Bulusaraung mountain range in Pangkajene and Islands Regency. The discovery was reported at around 2 p.m.
